items.title: fight-button-overlaps-fighters
items.claim: In Image #14, the FIGHT button overlaps the lower portions of both fighters’ inward-facing legs.
items.reason: The introduction obscures part of the fighters’ silhouettes before the player begins.
items.suggest: Place the FIGHT button within the introduction’s text area, clear of both fighter silhouettes.

items.title: intro-controls-lack-instructions
items.claim: Image #2 labels the sticks STANCE and TECHNIQUE but does not show the action mappings that are visible in Image #3.
items.reason: The player sees the invitation to fight before seeing which directions perform which actions.
items.suggest: Show the directional action legend during the qualifier introduction, not only in the fighting view.

items.title: direction-symbols-disagree
items.claim: In Image #5, the stick sectors use chevrons while the instruction panel uses filled triangles for the corresponding directions.
items.reason: Players must translate between two visual representations of the same inputs.
items.suggest: Use matching direction words on the stick sectors and in the legend, with action-specific Font Awesome icons where useful.

items.title: result-poses-lack-outcome-distinction
items.claim: In Image #18, ASMONGOLD WINS appears above Asmongold in a kicking pose and HasanAbi in a guard pose rather than visually distinct outcome poses.
items.reason: The text communicates victory, but the fighter presentation still resembles an exchange.
items.suggest: Give the result presentation a winner salute and a distinct loser recovery pose; this frame alone does not establish whether either existing animation is frozen.

items.title: technique-text-size-unverified
items.claim: In Image #6, the scoring metadata appears smaller than the technique names, but their exact CSS font sizes cannot be established from this screenshot.
items.reason: Height and point value are essential information when choosing a technique, so their readability needs verification.
items.suggest: Measure computed font sizes for the technique names, scoring metadata, and legends at 390×844; raise anything below 18 CSS px and stack metadata beneath names if necessary.
